title: Nuxtathon
description: The second **Nuxt** community hackathon. Two days across the whole ecosystem: [`nuxt/nuxt`](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt), every `nuxt/*` and `nuxt-modules/*` repository, and the modules on [nuxt.com](https://nuxt.com/modules).
rules: Issues count when they were created before 29 September.
A pull request counts when it was opened during the event and is merged before the results are frozen.
Work on a repository you maintain yourself does not count.
Pull requests that close no issue, such as migrating a module to Nuxt v5 (label `nuxtathon-v5`), are reviewed by the organizers.
